scope:
Map recorded artifacts to paper tasks; never certify performance or release.

This standard-library report checks a small, explicit set of task fields and
artifact provenance. It does not audit every simulator setting, learning
curve, metric reduction, independent seed registration, or method assumption.
interpretation: Counts describe indexed artifacts only. Basic task checks are not full protocol equivalence. No scores are compared, seeds pooled, or release claims certified. Incomplete is an artifact state, not a scheduler query.
csv_record_separator: LF; cell values unchanged from standard CSV output
